seatedToss.guidance: Tena ɛpon so, na mo mu biara nto bɔɔlo a ɛyɛ nyinaa kɔ botae kɛseɛ no mu. Kyerɛw nsɛnkyerɛnne no wɔ krataa so, mo ne ho.
steps: Print botae no ne nsɛnkyerɛnne krataa no, na tena so ɛpon so wɔ mo ntam.
Tena ahomegyeɛ mu, mo baanu mo ntam. Mo mu biara nto bɔɔlo koro, anaasɛ ɔntɔ a ɛyɛ.
Sɛ bɔɔlo no hyɛ koro bi mu a, nea ɔtoo no twe kɔnkyɛ bi wɔ ne kɔlɔm mu, wɔ koro no ananmu so.
Sɛ wopɛ a, mo ne ho hwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne no nyinaa bere a moagyae. Obiara nhia sɛ ɔbɛbɔ akontaa.
Gyae bere biara a obi no pɛ sɛ ɔgyae.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Fa bɔɔlo a wɔawe ne kata yiye anaasɛ sɔks a wɔakyekyere no nkyɛ nko. Gyina ɛpon so, nto kɔ obi anim so, na ma obi a panin bi nni akyiri. Nneɛma ketewa yɛ asiane sɛ obi bɛhwe.
flags: Ɛnsɛ ma mmofra a wɔn mfe ase 3: nneɛma ketewa
safety: Paw bɔɔlo a ɛwe kata yiye, anaasɛ kyekyere sɔks a ɛyɛ pɛ. Hwɛ no ansa na woaton, na wonhwɛ sɛ ɛwɔ abɔnsu anaa nkaterɛ a ɛnyɛ den, na nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu renfiri mu.
Aburoo, ɛmo ne nneɛma ketewa afoforɔ a wɔde ahyɛ mu yɛ asiane sɛ obi bɛhwe. Fa ɛno ... kɔ mmofra ketewa ne obiara a ɔde nneɛma to ano mu no nkyɛn.
Gyina nsa ntɛnteɛ mu, na hwɛ yie sɛ biribi bɛkɔ ano mu.
Gyina ɛpon so. Tɔ no yiye, fam, kɔ botae a ɛwɔ ɛpon so no nkyɛn, na mfa nkɔ ɔhwɛ anim so.

steps: Ntoma nkyerɛwde nyinaa. Nkyerɛwde a ɛdi kan no yɛ amanneɛ yi ne kuta no mfonini.
Obiara fa nkyerɛwde baako anaa pii na ɔtwe.
Ɛnhia sɛ loro ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so twe no nyinaa yɛ pɛ. Nkyerɛwde nyinaa yɛ mfonini baako ho ho.
Hyehyɛ nkyerɛwde no sɛnea wɔakyerɛw no, afei fa tepu to wɔn akyi.
Fa kuta no kɔ baabi a obiara bɛhwɛ.
coloringWall.mapLabel: Kuta no ntwerɛ: nkyekyɛmu {down}, nkyerɛwde {across} wɔ nkyekyɛmu biara mu, na wɔakyerɛw no fi A1 kosi {last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde nketewa tɔ no kyerɛ nkyerɛwde biara ano. Hyehyɛ nkyerɛwde no ano ano wɔ so, anaa ma ɛnsɛ nkyerɛwde no so kakra.

cards.prompt: Aduane hwa bɛn na wopɛ ne hu paa wɔ mukaase?
Keki bɛn na wopɛ sɛ wode di afahyɛ anaa ayɛ anigyeɛ?
Ka aduaba dɛdɛ bi a wopɛ ne we kyerɛ me.
Kwan bɛn so na wopɛ sɛ wo tii anaa kɔfe teɛ?
Anɔpa aduane pa bɛn na ɛma w’ani gye paa?
Woate aduaba pɛn afiri dua anaa ahaban so pɛn anaa?
Nea ɛyɛ dɛ anaa nea ɛyɛ nnyenennyene: emu nea ɛwɔ he na wopɛ paa?
Aduane bɛn na wodi a, ɛma wokae berɛ a awia bɔ denden?
Ka ofie bi a wotenaa mu a w’ani gyee ho kyerɛ me.
Ɛhefa na wopɛ sɛ wotena gye w’ahome paa?
Anwummerɛ a asomdwoeɛ wom no, dɛn na wopɛ sɛ woyɛ?
Agyapadeɛ a ɛsom bo bɛn na wode bɛto adaka sononko mu?
Hwan na wobɛfrɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛnom tii nkɔmɔ mfa mma mo?
Da a nsuo retɔ no, dɛn na w’ani gye ho sɛ woyɛ?
Nhwiren bɛn na w’ani bɛgye ho sɛ wobɛdua wɔ turo mu?
Ka dua anaa baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ fɛ a wopɛ kyerɛ me.
Sɛ wowɔ turo mu a, dɛn na ɛhɔ yɛ dɛ paa ma wo?
Nhwiren kɔla bɛn na w’ani gye ho paa?
Wopɛ sɛ nhwiren anaa ahaban gu ofie mu anaa?
Da a owia bɔ fɛfɛɛfɛ no, dɛn na wobɛpɛ sɛ woyɛ?
Ka kraman bi a wonim no ho asɛm kyerɛ me.
Agyinamoa anaa kraman, anaa emu biara? Dɛn na w’ani gye ho wɔ wɔn ho?
Anoma bɛn na wotumi hu wɔn anaa wote wɔn nne wɔ abɔnten?
Woakɔ apofofoɔ pɛn, anaa woayɛn nsuomnam pɛn?
Abowa bɛn na woahunu no a ne ho yɛ fɛ paa sene biara?
Ka kaa bi a wopɛɛ n’asɛm ho asɛm kyerɛ me.
Wobɛpɛ sɛ wode da koro kɔ mpoano anaa mmepɔ so?
Ɛhefa na wobɛpɛ sɛ wokɔtu kwan kɔhunu hɔ?
Sɛ wubetumi atu akɔfa baabiara atifi a, ɛhefa na wobɛkɔ?
Akwantuo bɛn na wokɔeɛ a ɛmaa w’ani gyee paa?
Adwuma bɛn na woyɛeɛ a w’ani gyee ho paa?
Agodie anaa adwuma ketewa bɛn na wubetumi de dɔnhwerew pii ayɛ?
Dɛn na nkurɔfoɔ nim wo sɛ wotumi yɛ anaa wosiesie no yie?
Afotuo bɛn na wode bɛma abofra anaa aberanteɛ a ɔrefiri adwuma aseɛ?
Nnwom bɛn na ɛma wopɛ sɛ wosa anaa wosi wo nan fam?
Dɛn na ɛma apontɔɔ anaa afahyɛ bi yɛ dɛ paa?
Dwomtofoɔ bɛn na w’ani gye ho sɛ wotie ne dwom?
Sini anaa telebihyɛn dwumadie bɛn na w’ani gye ho sɛ wobɛhwɛ bio?
Berɛ a owia bɔ yie no, dɛn na w’ani gye ho paa?
Berɛ a ahaban reporɔ no, dɛn na ɛyɛ dɛ ma wo?
Anwummerɛ a awɔ wom no, dɛn na woyɛ de gye w’ani anaa wode hyɛ wo ho mumu?
Sɛ nhwiren refiri aseɛ refefɛ a, nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛn na ɛkyerɛ wo sɛ berɛ foforɔ aduru?
Sukyene, nsuotɔ anaa awia: emu nea ɛwɔ he na wopɛ paa?
